recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit current source for the archived 2015May page; if a current generated ToC again lets a subordinate profile or search-parameter page displace a main resource link, fix the current TOC generation path.
issue_request: FHIR-7415 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It requested that the 2015May core ToC section 4.20 link point to Resource Observation - Content instead of Observation-genetics-cg-prf-1a-Observation-chromosome-genomicstart.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 6537. In Git, e7652985fb8e23b144184947fd38e005ab11c3a0 is the imported revision titled '#7412, #7415, #7417, 7420 - fix ToC', and it changed the publisher TOC duplicate-entry behavior so a subordinate page no longer displaced the first non-IG resource entry for the same section number.
additional_context: The issue is an archived DSTU1/2015May output symptom. Current build-scope source still includes toc.html as an active special page, source/toc.html inserts the generated ToC, source/fhir.ini actively includes observation=Observation, and source/hierarchy.xml lists Observation under Diagnostics. The old Observation genetics chromosome/genomicstart target is absent from current source, while build.fhir.org/toc.html links observation.html as '10.1 Resource Observation - Content'. Related combined-branch audits for FHIR-7417, FHIR-7420, and FHIR-7479 document the same historical duplicate-link family but do not decide FHIR-7415.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit because the historical svn/Git fix and the current maintained ToC already satisfy the requested Observation link correction.
